    *   *Why is it a problem?* It violates the Law of Non-Contradiction ($\neg(P \land \neg P)$) and the Law of Excluded Middle ($P \lor \neg P$) in the context of assigning truth values.     *   *What is Russell's Paradox?* "The set of all sets that do not contain themselves." Let $R = \{x \mid x \notin x\}$. Is $R \in R$? If yes, then by definition no. If no, then by definition yes. Contradiction.
